facts.text: A solo road trip across the United States is what got me into photography.
I shoot travel, landscape, video, wildlife and real estate work.
My cameras are a Sony A7 IV and a Canon EOS R6 Mark II.
My main lenses are Sony G Master II zooms: a 16-35mm and a 24-70mm.
For wildlife I use a 200-600mm lens.
I also fly a DJI Mavic 3 Pro and use a DJI RS 3 Pro gimbal for video.
My support kit is carbon fiber tripods, ball heads and Arca-Swiss plates.
